caption: The drawing shows a single object resembling a pair of tongs or sugar tongs, positioned horizontally in the center of the page. The object is depicted in pencil or graphite, resulting in various shades of gray on an off-white or beige background. The tongs have a slightly curved, looped shape and feature ornate, symmetrical patterns along both arms, including intertwining bands and small leaf-like motifs. Both ends of the tongs terminate in a fan or shell-shaped form. The thicker, solid section on one arm appears to be engraved with faint, small text. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, “WALTON, KARAMIAN” is printed in uppercase letters. The rest of the sheet is empty, with some light spots and faint discoloration around the edges.
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
